title: Cold plate with the library's FNO
description: This is the cold plate of `examples/nvidia/07_omniverse_physicsnemo_coldplate`, with the library's own `FNO2d` in place of PhysicsNeMo's FNO. Nothing outside PINNeAPPle is needed. Independent physical-validation controls and a separate multi-seed held-out FNO study are documented in EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.md; they are not yet a certified result.

metrics.name: test_rel_l2
metrics.how: mean relative L2 of T - T_c over 50 held-out layouts

metrics.name: max_hotspot_error_K
metrics.how: max over test layouts of |max T_FNO - max T_FV|

metrics.name: fno_parameters
metrics.how: trainable parameters of FNO2d (width 32, 12 modes, 4 layers)

checks.name: PDE residual (certified energy-error bound)
checks.detail: ||r||_{L^-1} / sqrt(min a) / ||u||_A from the finite-volume residual f + div(a grad u); bounds the relative energy-norm distance to the discrete solution

checks.name: PDE residual (certified L2 error bound)
checks.detail: the energy bound with the discrete Poincare inequality: bounds the relative L2 distance of u to the discrete solution

checks.name: boundary condition u = 0
checks.detail: RMS of u on the boundary (linear extrapolation from the first two cells) over max |u|

checks.name: flux balance (net boundary flux = source)
checks.detail: |outflow - integral of f| / |integral of f|, outflow = sum of 2 a u over the boundary faces

checks.name: positivity (maximum principle)
checks.detail: most negative value over max |u| (f >= 0 and u = 0 on the boundary give u >= 0)

checks.name: reference (relative L2)
checks.detail: relative L2 error against the reference solution (needs labels: evaluation only)

checks.name: applicability (coefficient inside the training envelope)
checks.detail: 4 of 50 coefficients outside the training envelope, e.g. high_fraction 0.382 outside [0.4, 0.605]

references: Li et al. 2021, Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations, ICLR
